messages:
mike: quick note — doing a sweep of the onboarding quickstarts. found two small but annoying problems in hello-lite: the env var used in the prose is RW_API, but the starter app reads REDWOOD_API_KEY. also the "Deploy -> checklist" link points to a deprecated path. opening a tiny PR to normalize names, add a compatibility shim, and patch the link. cc @anya @kevin :wave:

anya: thanks! can you paste the exact mismatch so i can align the Python and Node snippets? i can also run the compose smoke locally. :mag:

mike: current doc snippet (confusing):

```bash
# doc previously suggested
export RW_API=sk-...
# run dev
npm run dev
```

fix in my branch: use REDWOOD_API_KEY as canonical and note backward-compat:

```bash
# canonical
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...
# docker: add to .env: REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...
# starter app will also read RW_API for a short migration window
```

kevin: good call adding a shim. can you show the shim line you'll add in the starter? i'll do a quick grep across repos to find other docs using RW_API.

mike: added this one-liner in the starter app (both node & python):

```js
// node starter
const API_KEY = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || process.env.RW_API;
```

```py
# python starter
API_KEY = os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY') or os.getenv('RW_API')
```

anya: perfect. small UX ask: surface a short Warning banner right above the "Start the app" step so users see the variable name before running commands. :warning:

mike: added a compact banner: "Tip: prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY. Starter accepts RW_API for compatibility but please migrate." kept it one line. also fixed the broken link (was /docs/deploy-old/checklist) to /docs/deploy/checklist and filed a redirect with infra. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499 — includes compose-smoke and linkcheck.

docs-ci: PR #499 opened by mike — checks running: compose-smoke, linkcheck, spellcheck. status: running.

kevin: spotted another place: the SDK example still shows old import path `@redwood/oldclient`. can we add a tiny SDK migration snippet showing new import and equivalent curl header (so people understand header -> sdk mapping)? e.g. curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` and node: `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'; const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })`

mike: added a 2-line SDK migration note and linked to the full migration guide. kept examples minimal. also added a one-line Token Rotation pointer to the secrets docs.

snippet-bot: found 3 other docs referencing RW_API -> flagged and opened issues: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/210,211,212

anya: once CI is green, please merge and update the Quickstart checklist page to mention the canonical env name. i'll run a manual compose smoke as a double-check.

mike: merging on green. i'll announce the tiny fix in #dev-experience after merge so folks know to stop using RW_API in new examples. thanks y'all :tada:
